_comment: Single source of truth for the eval-model identity on the vLLM path. run_vllm.py requires this file and it was never shipped, so `--evaluate` failed at validate_config() before reaching a model. Shaped after benchmarks/bfcl_v4/model_config_granite41.json so the two integrations describe a model the same way; the fields run_vllm.py actually reads are registry_name, dtype and max_model_len, which feed the printed `vllm serve` hint.
_serve_comment: CCTU needs STRUCTURED tool calls. Without a tool-call parser vLLM returns them as text, this harness does not execute those, and `acc` is 0 for every episode for a harness reason rather than a model one -- which is why response_generator.py now refuses that case loudly. See ANCHOROPT.md, 'Known limits'.
_decode_comment: Reproduces response_generator.py's pinned defaults. The harness SENDS each of these explicitly rather than relying on a server default, and run_manifest.json records what was sent -- so these values are documentation, not configuration the run reads.
